name: Enara – LMS: connection check failed (EN)
subject: Action needed: check your Moodle connection

variables.sample: The class list service is off for the Enara tool in Moodle.
In the tool settings, set "IMS LTI Names and Role Provisioning" to use the service, then have a teacher open the activity once.

trigger: New code needed: 'Check connection' (on save, on demand, daily) plus a daily scan of lms_audit_log fail codes per platform
frequency: Immediate after a check that changed from OK to failed; from the scan max once per platform+cause per 24 h
